Subject: Final: IR runbook + sanitized telemetry bundle (BlueWave)

Tom / Liza — attaching the package for your SOC 2 review. Thanks for the quick turnaround on confirmations.

What we delivered:
- redwood_ir_runbook_v3.1.pdf (canonical IR runbook; internal-only sections marked)
- sanitized_telemetry_20280419.tgz (48h auth/edge logs around 2028-03-14 UTC; user IDs hashed; IPs pseudonymized)
- manifest_bluewave_20280418.txt (file list, SHA256 hashes, retention window = 7 days)
- redwood_ir_postmortem_bluewave_20280422.pdf (short postmortem and timeline for the auth spike)

Notes / highlights from the postmortem:
- Root cause: transient cache desynchronization in the auth gateway (a config propagation race) leading to ~2.4% increase in 5xx on token validation for ~31 minutes (2028-03-14T02:15:00Z — 2028-03-14T02:46:00Z).
- Mitigations implemented: immediate rollback of the propagation change, temporary rate-limiting on the affected gateway, and a follow-up kernel fix to the propagation handshake.
- Customer impact: limited to token validation errors; no user data leakage detected.
- Follow-ups: change to deployment gating for config propagation (owner: SRE), add an alert rule for propagation divergence (owner: infra-alerts), and plan a tabletop to validate the new gating.

Access: the Drive folder is: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC3dBlueWave-IR-Exchange
Folder expires in 7 days from delivery; if you need extended access or an SFTP transfer, tell us and we'll arrange it.

If you want a redacted version of the postmortem (remove internal-only playbook references) we can produce one in 24 hours.

Thanks — let me know if you need anything else for the SOC 2 assessment.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
